cards.example_en: Please paste the photo onto the card for your friend.
cards.example_zh: 请把这张照片粘到送给朋友的卡片上。

cards.example_en: Mum will pat the baby softly when he starts to cry.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝一开始哭，妈妈就会轻轻地拍他。

cards.example_en: A muddy path leads from the back gate to the field.
cards.example_zh: 一条泥泞的小路从后门通向操场。

cards.example_en: Please pause the film so we can fetch some snacks.
cards.example_zh: 请把电影暂停一下，我们去拿些零食。

cards.example_en: After dark, please keep to the pavement on your walk home.
cards.example_zh: 天黑以后走路回家，请走人行道。

cards.example_en: Back at the harbour, a pelican swallowed the fish it had caught.
cards.example_zh: 回到港口后，一只鹈鹕吞下了它抓住的鱼。

cards.example_en: This pencil costs fifty pence at the shop near school.
cards.example_zh: 这支铅笔在学校附近的商店卖五十便士。

cards.example_en: What percentage of the class passed?
cards.example_zh: 班上及格的百分比是多少？

cards.example_en: You need permission from your parents before the camping trip.
cards.example_zh: 野营旅行之前，你需要得到父母的许可。

cards.example_en: Farmers use less pesticide so the vegetables stay safer to eat.
cards.example_zh: 农民少用杀虫剂，这样蔬菜吃起来更安全。

cards.example_en: In the story a phantom appears in the old castle at night.
cards.example_zh: 故事里，一个幽灵在夜里出现在古堡中。

cards.example_en: In front of the palace, this photograph shows our whole family.
cards.example_zh: 这张照片是我们全家人在宫殿前拍的。

cards.example_en: Regular physical exercise helps students stay strong and healthy.
cards.example_zh: 经常进行身体锻炼有助于学生保持强壮和健康。

cards.example_en: A tall pine stands beside the path up the hill.
cards.example_zh: 一棵高大的松树立在上山的小路旁。

cards.example_en: Fresh pineapple tastes wonderful with cold yoghurt after sport.
cards.example_zh: 运动之后，新鲜菠萝配上冰酸奶，味道好极了。

cards.example_en: Water leaked from the pipe.
cards.example_zh: 管子漏水了。

cards.example_en: She wore a plain dress to the family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一条朴素的裙子去参加家庭晚餐。

cards.example_en: The train leaves from platform 4.
cards.example_zh: 火车从4号站台出发。

cards.example_en: My little sister goes to playschool every weekday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹每个工作日早上都去幼儿园。

cards.example_en: A pleasant breeze cooled us during the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 野餐时，一阵令人愉快的微风让我们凉快下来。

cards.example_en: The plot twisted when the detective guessed wrong.
cards.example_zh: 侦探猜错的时候，剧情发生了转折。

cards.example_en: The plump baker smiled and handed us warm bread.
cards.example_zh: 那位丰满的面包师微笑着递给了我们热面包。

cards.example_en: The flag hangs from a tall pole.
cards.example_zh: 旗子挂在一根高杆上。

cards.example_en: Ducks swam on the pond.
cards.example_zh: 鸭子在池塘里游。

cards.example_en: Speakers at the fair played pop all afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 集市的喇叭放了一下午流行音乐。

cards.example_en: During the funny film, we shared a large box of popcorn.
cards.example_zh: 看那部有趣的电影时，我们分吃了一大盒爆米花。

cards.example_en: Pack your possessions carefully before you leave the hotel room.
cards.example_zh: 离开旅馆房间之前，请小心收拾你的财物。

cards.example_en: Mum mixed milk powder with warm water for the baby.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈用温水给宝宝冲了奶粉。

cards.example_en: At the seaside restaurant, the prawn soup tasted fresh and hot.
cards.example_zh: 海滨餐馆的对虾汤尝起来又鲜又热。

cards.example_en: Time is precious before an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前时间很珍贵。

cards.example_en: Seat belts prevent serious injury on the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 安全带可以防止校车上发生严重伤害。

cards.example_en: Above the open grassland, the eagle searched for prey.
cards.example_zh: 在开阔的草原上空，鹰在搜寻猎物。

cards.example_en: This morning the principal spoke to parents at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，校长在校门口对家长讲话。

cards.example_en: The old prison is now a museum beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 那座旧监狱现在成了河边的博物馆。

cards.example_en: Every month the prisoner wrote a long letter to his family.
cards.example_zh: 那名囚犯每个月都给家人写一封长信。

cards.example_en: Making paper turned out to be a slow process in art club.
cards.example_zh: 在美术社团里，造纸成了一个缓慢的过程。

cards.example_en: At the city concert hall, the young prodigy played the piano.
cards.example_zh: 在市音乐厅，那位年少的神童弹奏了钢琴。

cards.example_en: The professor explained the theory clearly.
cards.example_zh: 教授把理论讲得很清楚。

cards.example_en: In a sentence, a pronoun can take the place of a name.
cards.example_zh: 在句子里，代词可以用来代替名字。

cards.example_en: Check the pronunciation in a dictionary.
cards.example_zh: 在词典里查发音。

cards.example_en: Starting a chess club was her proposal to the teacher.
cards.example_zh: 成立国际象棋社团，是她向老师提出的倡议。

cards.example_en: This job offers a good career prospect.
cards.example_zh: 这份工作有很好的职业前景。

cards.example_en: Eggs are a good source of protein.
cards.example_zh: 鸡蛋是很好的蛋白质来源。

cards.example_en: Use a protractor to measure the angle in your maths book.
cards.example_zh: 用量角器量一量你数学书里的角。

cards.example_en: On the way to school, the child jumped over a deep puddle.
cards.example_zh: 在上学的路上，那个孩子跳过了一个深水坑。

cards.example_en: Suddenly a puff of wind blew the paper off the picnic table.
cards.example_zh: 突然一阵风把纸从野餐桌上吹走了。

cards.example_en: Farmers use a pump to draw water from the deep well.
cards.example_zh: 农民用泵从深井里抽水。

cards.example_en: On a cold autumn evening, we made pumpkin soup for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的秋夜，我们做了南瓜汤当晚餐。

cards.example_en: Every pupil has a workbook.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生都有一本练习册。

cards.example_en: Whenever someone comes home, our puppy runs to the door.
cards.example_zh: 每当有人回家，我们的小狗就跑向门口。

word.example_en: The fence can prevent the dog from running out.
Please stop the ball from rolling into the road.
word.example_zh: 请别让球滚到马路上去。
